versions.content: Within SoAd_TcpConnected() SoAd shall change the state of the socket connection to SOAD_SOCON_ONLINE in case all of the following conditions are true: (1) Current connection state is not SOAD_SOCON_ONLINE (2) TCP socket (3) SoAdSocket Tcp Ini tiate is set to TRUE

Within SoAd_TcpConnected() SoAd shall change the state of the socket connection to SOAD_SOCON_ONLINE in case all of the following conditions are true: (1) Current connection state is not SOAD_SOCON_ONLINE (2) TCP socket (3) SoAdSocket Tcp Ini tiate is set to TRUE

Within SoAd_TcpConnected () SoAd shall change the state of the socket connection to SOAD_SOCON_ONLINE in case all of the following conditions are true: 1. Current connection state is not SOAD_SOCON_ONLINE 2. TCP socket 3. SoAdSocketTcpInitiate is set to TRUE
